0022600124.text: The Suns are 1-1 this season, 1 game back in second place in the Pacific and 10th in the West, and they come in having won their most recent game. The Thunder are 2-0, first in the Northwest and third in the West, on a two-game win streak, with Nikola Topic (back surgery), Otega Oweh (Achilles surgery) and Thomas Sorber (knee surgery) unavailable, while Phoenix is without Mark Williams (shoulder surgery) and Oso Ighodaro (oblique strain). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Suns lost the 2025-26 regular-season series 2-3 and the 2025-26 playoff series 0-4, including a 131-122 loss in Phoenix on April 27, 2026.
